results.sql_text:
WITH bounds AS (
  SELECT MAX(month) AS max_month FROM marts.property_sales
)
SELECT
  s.suburb,
  SUM(s.n_sold) AS n_sold,
  SUM(s.total_sale_value) AS total_sale_value
FROM marts.property_sales s
CROSS JOIN bounds b
WHERE s.property_type = 'house'
  AND s.month > b.max_month - INTERVAL '12 months'
GROUP BY s.suburb
ORDER BY n_sold DESC
LIMIT 20

results.golden_answer:
Over the 12 months to June 2026 the suburbs with the most house sales were Dubbo
(999), Orange (874), Port Macquarie (691), Austral (593) and Armidale (586). The
top of the list is regional: Dubbo and Orange alone account for more house
sales than any Sydney suburb, with Austral the only metropolitan entry, driven
by new-estate completions.

results.golden_sql:
SELECT suburb, sum(n_sold) AS n_sold
FROM marts.property_sales
WHERE property_type = 'house'
  AND month >= (SELECT max(month) FROM marts.property_sales) - interval '11 months'
GROUP BY suburb
ORDER BY n_sold DESC
LIMIT 5
